title: Pan-Seared Monkfish with Tunisian Spice
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring the tender monkfish, marinated in a blend of Tunisian spices and pan-seared to perfection.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the monkfish fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the monkfish to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the monkfish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the thinly sliced yellowed onion and cook until caramelized.
Stir in the Tunisian spice blend and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the monkfish on skewers with a spoonful of the caramelized onion mixture and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
